style: Style: flat cartoon children's-book science illustration, thick dark outlines, soft clean colours, simple friendly shapes, one single subject only, centred, square picture. The subject is isolated on a plain pure white background with no ground, no shadow and no other objects. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no arrows, no symbols anywhere.
